primary_article_claim: The frozen Step29 MS3 regulator architecture (FOXM1, MYBL2, E2F8, TFDP1, E2F1 and BRCA1) was independently associated with the MS3-like proliferative/mitotic pole at the patient-pseudobulk level, with preserved positive direction in all leave-one-patient-out analyses.
secondary_article_observation: The frozen MS6 regulator set (HNF4A, NR1H4, NR1I3, CEBPA and FOXA3) showed cell-level concordance with the hepatic/metabolic pole, but was not reproduced at the patient-pseudobulk level.
claim_boundary: No external GRN discovery was performed.
TF expression is not equivalent to regulon activity.
MS3 regulatory architecture is the primary externally supported result.
MS6 regulatory architecture is retained as secondary cell-level evidence only.
